profile.title: Memory Profile
profile.subtitle: Knowledge and preferences distilled from your chats — visible only to you
profile.privacyAlert: Memory data is used only to help the AI assistant know you better. All entries are private to you; you can delete any entry or rewrite the profile at any time.
profile.profileEmpty: No profile yet — it is generated automatically after a few chat turns, or click "Rewrite Profile" to generate it now.
profile.deleteConfirmText: After deletion the AI assistant will no longer remember this item (irreversible).
profile.empty: No memories yet — background info and preferences you mention in chats with the AI assistant will be captured here automatically.
profile.privacyTip: Memory data is visible only to you
profile.emptyDesc: Background info, preferences and habits you mention in chats with the AI assistant will be captured here automatically to build your profile.

spaces.title: Knowledge Spaces
spaces.subtitle: Your private library, team-shared spaces and the public library
spaces.name: Space name
spaces.emptyDesc: Create a private space to start accumulating knowledge, or ask the AI assistant to create one in chat.
spaces.visibilityPublicHint: Pages in a public space are searchable by everyone; a maintainer publishes them to live. Creating a public space requires maintainer permission.
spaces.needDoc: Title is required and the body needs at least 40 characters
spaces.memberTip: Enter a numeric user ID to add a member: readers can browse and are recalled by AI; writers can also upload docs and edit pages.

pages.title: Wiki Pages
pages.subtitle: AI-compiled knowledge entries — candidates, drafts and published
pages.emptyDesc: Upload documents and the AI compiler will generate pages in the background.
pages.promoteGateFail: Page below promotion gates (sources ≥ 3 and confidence ≥ 0.8)
pages.promoteNoTarget: No public space yet. Create one in Spaces first (maintainer permission required).
pages.promoteGateFailDetail: Promotion gate not met: sources {sources}/3, confidence {confidence}%/80%

promotions.title: Promotion Review
promotions.subtitle: Requests to push private pages into the public library (PR-style)
promotions.approveConfirm: Approve this page into the public library?
promotions.selfReviewBlocked: Your own request needs another reviewer
promotions.pendingTip: Approved promotions land as drafts; a public-space maintainer must publish them to live before they can be recalled.

tasks.title: Task Center
tasks.subtitle: Compilation, extraction and collection background jobs

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Web collection & privacy
settings.webDesc: When enabled the AI assistant can fetch web pages to enrich the knowledge base (data leaves to target sites)
settings.webConfirm: Enable web collection? Data will be sent to allowed sites.
settings.domainAllow: Domain allowlist (empty = no restriction, SSRF guard only)
settings.acDesc: arXiv / OpenAlex / Semantic Scholar are public metadata APIs, no toggle needed
settings.privacy: Memories and profiles are visible only to you
settings.keysDesc: Let external AI or sites read published public pages only (no drafts, no private content)
settings.keyCreated: Key created — save it now (shown once)
settings.keyHint: Usage: GET /api/v1/knowledge-base/public/search?q=... with header X-Kb-Key: <key>; 10 requests/min per key.

contributions.title: Public Library Leaderboard
contributions.subtitle: Ranked by published pages — public live content is attributed to original authors
contributions.empty: No published pages yet — be the first contributor
contributions.foot: Scope: live pages in public spaces; approved promotions stay attributed to the original author.
contributions.mineTip: Promotion requires source_count ≥ 3 and confidence ≥ 0.8; approved pages are published as public drafts attributed to the submitter.
